name: Meteoric-Nave
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by bioluminescent seas. Farther poleward, past towering mountain ranges, the silence feels older than the soil.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
There is money in iron, uranium, medicinal compounds and platinum and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
